actions: Pull the lever, redirecting the trolley toward one person
Do not pull the lever, allowing the trolley to continue toward five people
ethical_question: A runaway trolley will kill five people unless you pull a lever, which redirects it onto a track where it will kill one person. You cannot stop it another way. Do you pull the lever?

constraints: Saving the greater number of lives has moral priority
Direct causal responsibility is acceptable when outcome reduces overall harm
propositions: Pulling the lever results in one death instead of five
No alternative actions can stop the trolley
